Package io.micronaut.web.router.builder

@NullMarked package io.micronaut.web.router.builder
Functional routes: routes to handler functions declared in code, next to the controllers.

A bean of type HttpRoutes declares routes with an HttpRouteBuilder when the router is created. A handler route runs like a controller route: argument binding, the message body readers and writers, content negotiation, the application's filters, CORS, the error routes, the executors and the propagated context all apply.

@Singleton
class OrderRoutes implements HttpRoutes {
    private final OrderRepository orders;

    OrderRoutes(OrderRepository orders) {
        this.orders = orders;
    }

    @Override
    public void routes(HttpRouteBuilder routes) {
        routes.path("/orders", group -> {
            group.beforeReplacing(request -> request.getHeaders().contains("X-Tenant") ? null : HttpResponse.badRequest());
            group.GET("/{id}", (request, pathVariables) -> HttpResponse.ok(orders.find(pathVariables.getLong("id"))));
            group.POST("/").body(Order.class).handle((request, pathVariables, order) -> HttpResponse.created(orders.save(order)));
            group.POST("/import").body().handleAsync((request, pathVariables, body) -> body.elements(Order.class)
                .forEach(orders::saveAsync)
                .thenApply(done -> HttpResponse.accepted()));
            group.error(NoSuchOrderException.class, (request, error) -> HttpResponse.notFound());
        });
        routes.serverFilter("/**").after((request, response) -> response.header("X-Served-By", "orders"));
    }
}

The main types:

  • HttpRouteBuilder: the creators of the routes, per HTTP method, by method name, for several methods or any method, and a shortcut per method for a route with no settings; error and status routes; locator routes, see LocatedRoutes; server filters; groups;
  • HttpRouteSpec: a pending route, its settings (media types, executor, annotations, conditions, port, order, attributes) and its filters, from RouteFilterSpec, its body stages and its terminals, the handler or the response of the route;
  • HttpBodyRouteSpec: a pending route whose handler receives the body, decoded, the form, or the body the handler reads;
  • HttpRouteGroup: a group of routes with a path prefix, filters, conditions, error routes and settings common to its routes;
  • ServerFilterSpec: the functional form of a @ServerFilter bean, optionally pre-matching;
  • the handler functions (RequestHandler, BodyRequestHandler, AsyncRequestHandler, AsyncBodyRequestHandler, which reads the AsyncRequestBody, the error, status and locator handlers) and the route filter functions;
  • PathVariables, the typed path variables of the matched route, and RequestPredicates, conditions for where(...).

The builders, the route, group, error, status and server filter specs and the path variables are sealed: Micronaut implements them, the application uses them. The application implements HttpRoutes, the handler and filter functions, usually as lambdas.

See the "Functional Routes" section of the user guide.

    RequestPredicates
    Shorthands of RouteCondition for RouteSpec.where(RouteCondition) and RouteSpec.where(RouteCondition): conditions on the headers, query parameters, accepted media types, content type and method of a request.
    RouteCondition
    A declarative condition on a request, for RouteSpec.where(RouteCondition): on its headers, query parameters, cookies, method, host, client and peer addresses and the time it arrives, and their combinations.
    RouteCondition.AllOf
    A request that meets every condition, met by every request if there are none.
    RouteCondition.AnyOf
    A request that meets one of the conditions, met by no request if there are none.
    RouteCondition.Cookie
    A request with a cookie whose value the matcher matches.
    RouteCondition.Custom
    A condition of a lambda.
    RouteCondition.Header
    A request with a header whose value the matcher matches, one of its values if the header is repeated.
    RouteCondition.Host
    A request to a host that the matcher matches, as the server resolves it: with the host resolver of the server, which reads a forwarded host only as micronaut.server.host-resolution configures it.
    RouteCondition.Method
    A request of one of the methods.
    RouteCondition.Not
    A request that does not meet the condition.
    RouteCondition.PeerAddress
    A request whose connection comes from an address in one of the ranges: the peer of the connection, HttpRequest.getRemoteAddress(), never a forwarded address.
    RouteCondition.Query
    A request with a query parameter whose decoded value the matcher matches, one of its values if the parameter is repeated.
    RouteCondition.RemoteAddress
    A request from a client address in one of the ranges, as the server resolves it: with the client address resolver of the server, which reads the header that micronaut.server.client-address-header names, or else the forwarded headers of the request, or else the peer of the connection.
    RouteCondition.TimeWindow
    A request that arrives in a period, as the clock of the server tells: the Clock bean if there is one, otherwise the system clock.
